<p align="center"><strong>Ending 02 of 06 - The Resident</strong></p>


<p align="center">You could leave. Instead, you turn back toward the warm attic light.</p>

<p align="center">The tea tastes of cinnamon and rain on warm stone. By the second cup, your feet no longer quite touch the floor.</p>

<p align="center">&quot;The garage has room for another desk,&quot; says the ghost.</p>

<p align="center">THE RESIDENT - You came looking for a way out. You found a place to build something.</p>
